cards.name: Second Guess
cards.oracleText: Counter target spell that's the second spell cast this turn.

cards.name: Second Breakfast
cards.oracleText: Up to two target creatures each get +2/+1 until end of turn. Create a Food token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life.")

cards.name: Second City
cards.oracleText:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast your second spell in a turn. When that mana is spent, create a Deep Dish Pizza token. (It's a Food artifact with "{3}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life and draw a card.")

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
{T}: Tap enchanted creature.
{T}: Untap enchanted creature.

cards.name: Second Thoughts
cards.oracleText:
Exile target attacking creature.
Draw a card.

cards.name: Second Little Pig
cards.oracleText: {2}{W/B}{W/B}: Second Little Pig perpetually becomes a Boar Spirit with base power and toughness 4/4 and gains flying. Activate only if Second Little Pig isn't a Spirit.

cards.name: Second Chance
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have 5 or less life, sacrifice this enchantment and take an extra turn after this one.

cards.name: Second Harvest
cards.oracleText: For each token you control, create a token that's a copy of that permanent.

cards.name: Second Sunrise
cards.oracleText: Each player returns to the battlefield all artifact, creature, enchantment, and land cards in their graveyard that were put there from the battlefield this turn.

cards.name: Second Sight
cards.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Look at the top five cards of target opponent's library, then put them back in any order.
• Look at the top five cards of your library, then put them back in any order.
Entwine {U} (Choose both if you pay the entwine cost.)

cards.name: Second Stage of Magic Design
cards.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell with a keyword or ability word, if it doesn't share a keyword or ability word with a permanent you control or a card in your graveyard, draw a card. (Keywords and ability words include abilities like flying, flashback, and landfall.)
